headline: Ground-Up Commercial Construction Preparation Checklist — Los Angeles
articleBody:
Ground-Up Commercial Construction Preparation Checklist for Los Angeles Clients

Before your Ground-Up Commercial Construction appointment with Opus Builders, make sure you have the following ready:

1. Measurements
2. Budget
3. Design preferences
4. Permits needed
5. Material selections

Contact Opus Builders at (818) 939-8855 to get started.
